spans.s:
फ 1. फ, the twenty-second consonant
of the Nāgarī alphabet and the second letter of the
fifth or labial class, being the aspirate of प्, and
said to be pronounced like फ् in uphill, loophole.
—फ-कार, अस्, m. the letter or sound फ्.

फा फा, फास्, m. heat; useless or idle
talk; growth, increase; one who increases, an in-
creaser; [cf. 2. फ.]
